lines: A big Space stays quick while it syncs: a sync pass reads only the records it touches, not every record of the type.
Long lists page through tens of thousands of records in a fraction of a second instead of tens of seconds.
Using a saved key, making new records and keeping the live view current all cost far less work on a busy server.
A record made in Vyre is matched, never duplicated, when the same person later arrives from a synced app.
Syncs with an outside app run on their own schedule, as the person who set them up.
